crossRefs.note: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.

translations.web: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.
translations.bsb: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners do the same.
translations.kjv: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
translations.asv: And if ye do good to them that do good to you, what thank have ye? for even sinners do the same.
